facts.text: Students can finish 14 degrees on site at Penn State Brandywine or begin any of more than 275 Penn State majors before transitioning through the 2+2 plan.

sources.title: Academics | Penn State Brandywine
sources.quote: With more than 275 Penn State majors that can be started at Penn State Brandywine, and completed at University Park or another Penn State location, Brandywine offers 14 baccalaureate degrees, 17 minors, 3 associate degrees
